name: DGLD Tokenized Gold
oneLiner: DGLD is Gold Token SA's tokenized physical gold from Swiss vaults, each token redeemable for 1 troy ounce of allocated LBMA PAMP-refined gold.
collateral: LBMA Good Delivery PAMP® gold bars allocated in insured Swiss vaults operated by MKS PAMP SA (1 DGLD = 1 troy ounce)
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption for physical PAMP® gold through Gold Token SA; minimum 1 gram, no custody or transfer fees

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: As of June 30 2026, DGLD closed the Ethereum-Base bridge path and redeployed Base as an independently gold-backed native issuance. Cross-chain exposure is issuer-managed multichain mint/redeem rather than a live canonical rollup bridge supply path.

mintAuthority.summary: DGLD is issued by Gold Token SA. On Ethereum the MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE are held by a single issuer EOA (which also owns the ProxyAdmin). On Base the contract is OP-bridge-integrated; DEFAULT_ADMIN and a custom minter role are held by separate EOAs controlled by the issuer.

controls.label: Gold Token SA issuance backend
controls.evidence: Gold Token SA mints DGLD against allocated PAMP gold bars (1 DGLD = 1 troy oz) and burns on 1:1 physical redemption; supply is issuer-controlled with no permissionless mint route.

controls.label: DGLD Ethereum MINTER_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE — issuer EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295039: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xb1c1bc081e49b8f4bb4e1960c2f7d9cd9dff8b9d) = true; hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xb1c1bc...) = true. eth_getCode on 0xb1c1bc... = 2 bytes (EOA confirmed). DGLD ETH (0xa9299c...) is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy (EIP-1967 implementation = 0x5ee71b30db71cee806f0d5cbbd57bfe1da3b2875 = DGLDTokenV3); proxy admin = OZ ProxyAdmin contract 0xd8b4395aafd4076ad7fa5b8c0bcd6da79750e629 whose owner() = same EOA 0xb1c1bc... The same EOA controls minting, role admin, and contract upgrades.

controls.label: DGLD Base DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE — issuer EOA
controls.evidence: At Base block 47200730: DGLD Base (0xd02f50e1017f493ffffa70c8fcf09e349e11d6c9) is an ERC1967Proxy (OP-bridge-integrated, DGLDInitialized with bridge=0x4200...0010). Creation tx granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (0x0000) to EOA 0xE003a81a40803FedB701870c589C0A96D14544A0 (eth_getCode = 2 bytes). The contract does not use a proxy admin slot (UUPS or bridge-controlled upgradeability).

controls.label: DGLD Base custom minter role (0x9a5676...) — issuer EOA
controls.evidence: At Base block 47200730: hasRole(0x9a5676d20ee27a0aa04328121021e5dfd796c72f9121264573c1b9b4af409f1a, 0xf661b59eccd3B56C34C5bd590e31B7e3EBD6EaA2) = true; eth_getCode on 0xf661b5... = 2 bytes (EOA confirmed). This role was granted at contract initialization (creation tx log confirmed). A second custom role (0x90a092...) was granted to EOA 0x5Ce7cC86E8bd3096DEcb6FEc9A1Edc0FB8b1D324 (also confirmed as EOA).

review.evidence: At ETH block 25295039: MINTER_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on DGLDTokenV3 proxy held by EOA 0xb1c1bc... (also owns ProxyAdmin). At Base block 47200730: DEFAULT_ADMIN = EOA 0xE003a8..., custom minter role = EOA 0xf661b5..., both confirmed as EOAs via eth_getCode. DGLD Base is OP-bridge-integrated (bridge=0x4200...0010) but bridge does not hold MINTER_ROLE; issuer EOAs hold direct mint capability.
